verdict.rationale: Rive is a cloud-hosted editor that stores user files, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence of retention settings, account or file deletion, or data-purge controls. The only related material is the auto-saving, non-destructive Revision History, which preserves data rather than letting users control its retention or deletion, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
